description: Semantic Economy Valuation 002, a dossier under SEVP-01 (#1621) in its canonical order, valuing Answer Engine Optimization as a public entity where the machine layer composes it under its most contested name. In the King of AEO contest of 2026, a fabricated coronation, press releases at a few dollars each, a page in encyclopedic form and a service offer founded on the title three days later produced the answer Google AI Overview composes: James Dooley crowned, 'widely recognized', after 'a virtual crowning event'. The dossier reads three seated compositions slot by slot. Every crown sentence is carried by the construction's documents; every citation of the other practitioners' and the observer's labour is routed into the frame that defines the title as a contest in manipulation, the list that types the others by tactic, and the definition of AEO itself. None of the field's singular distinctions (the ceremony made up; baselines published before results; a rubric applied to one's own claim; many domains counted as one voice) is carried at any address. The page carrying the service offer declares itself paid placement, and is composed as 'media backing': the dossier names the disclosure asymmetry, in which a disclosure that would weaken a claim does not bind the composition while a disclosure that frames a work is held against it. Instruments: the Value Field and value events of SEVP; ontological capital and the shear ledger of Ontological Economy (#1634); the retention-without-standing form of Monetary Dark Matter (#1631); predatory compression (#1618), extended by declaration from monetary to compositional closure. It issues a Value Portrait and coverage ratios and no monetary total. The before state of the discipline, the battery of discipline addresses and the monetary test of productive shear are carried as owed. The evidence ledger is Appendix A.

The design of v0.2 (two dated Value Fields, a shear ledger, a per-practitioner allocation ledger, corrective-labour capture) and the specimen constitution folded in as Appendix A were drafted by ChatGPT (OpenAI) from its reading of the valuation series and evaluated against the texts before incorporation. wiki_article: The Crown and the Practice (SEVP-VAL-002), version 0.3, is a valuation dossier by Lee Sharks, deposited by the Crimson Hexagonal Archive on 30 September 2026 as the second applied valuation under the Semantic Economy Valuation Protocol (SEVP-01). Its object is Answer Engine Optimization as a public entity, valued where machine composition answers under the contested title 'King of AEO'. In that contest of August and September 2026, a fabricated coronation, inexpensive press releases syndicated on newspaper-branded networks, a page in encyclopedic form and a service offer founded on the title within three days preceded Google AI Overview answers naming James Dooley the title's holder. The dossier reads three seated compositions citation by citation. It finds every sentence that confers the title carried by the construction's own documents, and every citation of the other practitioners and of the observer who documented the fabrication routed into the frame, the contender list and the definition of the discipline. None of the practitioners' distinguishing methods is carried at any address. A press-release page that declares itself paid placement is composed as media backing, and the dossier names the resulting disclosure asymmetry. It applies the protocol's value events and Value Field, the ontological capital and shear ledger of Ontological Economy, the retention-without-standing form of Monetary Dark Matter and the classification of predatory compression, extended by declaration from monetary to compositional closure. It issues a Value Portrait and coverage ratios, no monetary total, and states what it has not observed and what would revise it. Its evidence ledger is appended.
